value.title: Team USA, Ryoma Echizen
value.synopsis: After Ryoma is forced to withdraw from the Japan U-17 training camp, Ryoga invites him to play for the US team.

value.title: Pre-World Cup Kicks Off!
value.synopsis: Teams from all over the world competing in the U-17 World Cup gather to start things off with the Pre-World Cup exhibition matches.

value.title: A Moment Ahead in the Future
value.synopsis: With one win each, Japan and Germany continue to face off in the third match of the Pre-World Cup exhibition.

value.title: Prince vs Prince
value.synopsis: A mysterious man riding a horse suddenly challenges Ryoma to a tennis match on horseback!

value.title: Upset
value.synopsis: The World Cup Group League commences and Japan battles it out with Greece and Australia.

value.title: Absolute Away Game
value.synopsis: Team Japan’s #2 doubles players, Yukimura and Sanada, face a daunting match as the crowd is overwhelmingly filled with supporters for Australia, the home team.

value.title: Chess King
value.synopsis: Japan continues their match against Australia with #1 doubles. Atobe and Fuji take on a super offensive doubles pair with big serves.

value.title: One's Resolve... One's Conditions
value.synopsis: Having lost both doubles matches against Switzerland, Japan begins its decisive #3 singles between Akutsu and Switzerland’s Amadeus.

value.title: Feelings for My Friends
value.synopsis: Ryoma needs to decide if Team USA is where he truly belongs. Meanwhile, the teams gear up for the Finals Tournament that starts in two days.

value.title: Beyond the Bible
value.synopsis: The U-17 World Cup semi-final matches continue with France versus Japan. Can Kimijima and Shiraishi beat the aesthetically-inclined Tristan and Timothée of France in both tennis and charm?

value.title: The Worst Doubles Pair
value.synopsis: Team Japan’s Yanagi and Mori are partners for #1 doubles against France, but they obviously don’t get along at all. Can they smooth things out between them before it’s too late?

value.title: Prince of Ace
value.synopsis: It’s finally time for Ryoma to settle things with Chardard in #3 singles against France.

value.title: Samurai vs Knight
value.synopsis: Ryoma’s match with Chardard continues in #3 singles of Japan versus France. Whichever team is victorious will advance to play Germany.
